title: Non-Sterile Cell Analysis
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the provided source.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.15.0 or later) and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as described: Slot 1 – Temperature Module with a 96‑well V‑bottom plate; Slot 2 – 96‑well plate containing reagents placed in the same well numbers as a tube rack (A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2, B3, B4, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, D1, D2, D3, D4); Slot 3 – NEST 12‑well reservoir (A1 = FACS Buffer, A3 = ‘B6’ reagent for step 5, A12 = empty for liquid waste); Slot 4 – Opentrons 20 µL tip rack.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the labware, tip rack, and both pipettes (P20 Single‑channel on the left mount and P300 Multi‑channel on the right mount). Follow the on‑screen prompts and use the calibration tips supplied by Opentrons.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: In the OT App press “Run” to start the cell‑staining protocol on the OT‑2 robot.
